basic_details.job_title: Sub-Division Office Jaynagar Vikas Mitra Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Vikas Mitra post is vacant in Ekahri panchayat of Ladania block. It is open only to applicants from a Mahadalit family who live in that panchayat and belong to the caste listed for it in the notice, Chamar (Male). The Sub-Division Office (Anumandal Karyalaya), Jaynagar, Madhubani, Bihar has issued this very short-term advertisement notice. Candidates need at least Matric or equivalent and must be between 18 and 50 years of age on 25 November 2026. Applications are accepted online only, through the web application prepared by NIC, Madhubani, from 23 November 2026 to 2 December 2026.

how_to_apply: The District Magistrate, Madhubani has directed that the whole engagement process for the Vikas Mitra post be carried out only in online mode. Applications are made through the web application prepared by NIC, Madhubani.
The online application window runs from 23-11-2026 to 02-12-2026. The notice does not give the web address of the application or the documents to upload.

content_sections.heading: About SDO Jaynagar Vikas Mitra
content_sections.text: The Sub-Division Office, Jaynagar is the sub-divisional administration under Madhubani district in Bihar. The notice is signed by the Sub-Divisional Officer (Anumandal Padadhikari), Jaynagar. The post is to be filled against a created and sanctioned vacant post, on the orders of the District Magistrate, Madhubani, in letter No. 3440/Kalyan dated 10-10-2026. The engagement will follow these instructions: Letter No. 2376 dated 11-11-2022 of the Chief Executive Officer, Bihar Mahadalit Vikas Mission-cum-Secretary, Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Welfare Department, Bihar, Patna Letter No. 1349 dated 25-06-2024 from the same office The Vikas Mitra Selection Guidelines Letters issued from time to time

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy table in the notice gives the following details: The notice sets these eligibility conditions: Educational qualification: The minimum educational qualification is Matric or equivalent. Age limit: A Mahadalit applicant must be at least 18 years and at most 50 years old on 25-11-2026. Family: The applicant must be from a Mahadalit family. Caste: Only the caste with the highest Mahadalit dominance in the panchayat, as per the 2010 survey, will be considered eligible to apply. The candidate from the caste that is dominant in the panchayat or ward group (urban area) will be selected. The vacancy table lists this caste for Ekahri as Chamar (Male). Pre-determined dominance: The dominant Mahadalit caste in each panchayat and cluster has already been decided as per the 2010 survey. Residence: Applications will be taken only from residents of the panchayat, ward or ward group (urban area) for which the Vikas Mitra is to be selected. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For the complete eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SDO Jaynagar Vikas Mitra
content_sections.text: The District Magistrate, Madhubani has directed that the whole engagement process for the Vikas Mitra post be carried out only in online mode. Applications are made through the web application prepared by NIC, Madhubani. The online application window runs from 23-11-2026 to 02-12-2026 . The notice does not give the web address of the application or the documents to upload.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by a merit list. The candidate with the highest percentage in Matric or equivalent will be selected. Candidates with qualifications higher than Matric will get no additional benefit in selection. The notice does not mention an interview. The process is divided between the block and the sub-division: After the online application window closes, the applications received are downloaded. The merit list is then prepared and published at block level. Objections to the merit list are received and settled at sub-division level. The selection list is published at sub-division level. Appointment letters are distributed at sub-division level. The oath and the training-cum-orientation also take place there.

faq.question: Q1. How many Vikas Mitra vacancies are there in this SDO Jaynagar notice?
faq.answer: There is 01 Vikas Mitra vacancy. It is in Ekahri panchayat of Ladania block, Jaynagar sub-division, Madhubani.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Jaynagar Vikas Mitra post?
faq.answer: Online applications are accepted from 23 November 2026 to 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Vikas Mitra post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is Matric or equivalent. Candidates with higher qualifications get no additional benefit in selection.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Vikas Mitra post?
faq.answer: A Mahadalit applicant must be at least 18 years and at most 50 years old on 25-11-2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for the Ekahri panchayat Vikas Mitra post?
faq.answer: The applicant must be from a Mahadalit family and a resident of the panchayat. The applicant must also belong to the caste with the highest Mahadalit dominance there, which the vacancy table lists as Chamar (Male).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the SDO Jaynagar Vikas Mitra post?
faq.answer: Applications are made only online, through the web application prepared by NIC, Madhubani. The window runs from 23-11-2026 to 02-12-2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Vikas Mitra be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a merit list. The candidate with the highest percentage in Matric or equivalent is selected.

faq.question: Q8. When will the Vikas Mitra merit list be published?
faq.answer: The merit list will be published on 05-12-2026. Objections to it will be received and settled on 07-12-2026 and 08-12-2026.

faq.question: Q9. Can a person from outside Ekahri panchayat apply?
faq.answer: No. Applications will be taken only from residents of the panchayat, ward or ward group for which the Vikas Mitra is to be selected.
